page_title: FRE 2-1 MON | Freiburg v B. Monchengladbach 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
90+3' Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process. There is a free kick near the sideline to Freiburg.
90+1' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Noah Atubolu, who smothers the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Half-chance! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) plays a pass into the box, but Moritz Nicolas reacts well to snuff out the attack.
88' Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
87' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom right corner, but Moritz Nicolas keeps it out with an amazing save.
85' 2 - 1 Gooal! Kevin Stoger takes over corner duties. Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) gets his head on the ball from the corner and puts it into the right side of the net. 2:1.
85' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
85' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. B. Monchengladbach will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
83' The game has come to an end for Kevin Diks. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach).
83' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
81' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lucas Holer (Freiburg) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
79' The attendance is 34700.
79' Here's the change. Vincenzo Grifo leaves the pitch and Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
79' Julian Schuster has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lucas Holer (Freiburg) replacing Yuito Suzuki.
79' The linesman points to the corner flag, Freiburg are going to take it.

78' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Freiburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' A player from B. Monchengladbach commits a rough challenge. Daniel Siebert blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick is awarded to Freiburg.
77' Kota Takai (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card.
76' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
74' 2 - 0 Goal! Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:0.
74' Half-chance! Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) plays a pass into the box, but Moritz Nicolas reacts well to snuff out the attack.
74' B. Monchengladbach keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
71' Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) trips an opposition player and Daniel Siebert signals a foul. Freiburg have a free kick.
70' Kevin Diks (B. Monchengladbach) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Noah Atubolu makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
68' Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but Noah Atubolu comes off his line to gather the ball.
62' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
62' Hugo Bolin comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jens Castrop (B. Monchengladbach).
62' A substitution has been made. Lukas Ullrich goes off and Shuto Machino (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
62' Eugen Polanski has decided to substitute Yannik Engelhardt and he is replaced by Wael Mohya (B. Monchengladbach).
60' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
58' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
58' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
55' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
53' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) is flagged for offside.
52' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
51' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) sees a yellow card from Daniel Siebert after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

48' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed narrowly wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.

48' Philipp Treu (Freiburg) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! It's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
47' Daniel Siebert couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) and blew his whistle. B. Monchengladbach win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
46' The whistle blows and Daniel Siebert starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A lofted pass finds Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
45+1' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
45+1' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.
44' B. Monchengladbach fail to score from a corner as Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) leaps to collect the ball.
42' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
41' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to B. Monchengladbach.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Freiburg.
36' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
33' Half-chance! Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) plays a pass into the box, but Moritz Nicolas reacts well to snuff out the attack.

32' Haris Tabakovic (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
31' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
29' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach).
29' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Moritz Nicolas intercepts the ball.
28' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Moritz Nicolas.
28' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
27' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Daniel Siebert didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
27' Yannik Engelhardt (B. Monchengladbach) commits a rough challenge and Daniel Siebert blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Freiburg.
26' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

25' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it to the middle of the goal, but Noah Atubolu makes a comfortable save to stop his effort.
23' Kota Takai (B. Monchengladbach) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
22' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) serves up a nice cross, but Noah Atubolu punches the ball away.
19' The Freiburg players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
14' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.

12' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniel Siebert with no other option than to blow for a foul. Freiburg earn a free kick.
11' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
9' Philipp Treu (Freiburg) sends a long ball in, but Moritz Nicolas comfortably gathers the ball.
8' Freiburg are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' The free kick from close range, taken by Freiburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
3' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniel Siebert interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Freiburg.
3' Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
